evidence.excerpt: Dragana Pekez received her Dipl.-Ing. degree in electrical engineering from the Faculty of Technical Sciences, University of Novi Sad, in 2004, followed by her M.Sc. in 2008 and Ph.D. in 2014, both from the same institution. She has been a Senior Research Associate at the Department of Power, Electronics and Telecommunications since 2016. Her research focuses on numerical modelling of electric field distribution around medium-voltage composite and porcelain insulators, with particular emphasis on contaminated and wet surface conditions. The group applies finite element and boundary element methods using commercial and in-house simulation tools, supported by a high-voltage laboratory equipped for leakage current measurements and artificial pollution tests. She teaches courses in high-voltage engineering and electromagnetic field theory at undergraduate and postgraduate level.
